description: Default capability for compact widget + main dashboard webviews. Grants core IPC permissions used by tauri-plugin-updater + TauRPC handlers (cross-cutting envelope: health, app_info, ready, get_settings, update_settings per arch §Standard Contracts). Per-procedure granularity is not enforced at capability level — TauRPC dispatches all router methods through a single invoke handler; xtask capability-drift gate (route#22) introspects the router and asserts router-level coverage.
